# Thunderbird Calendar category-row visual review and fixup

The successful fixup directly above `cff6ceeea1b575b88560b98b10996764f892f465` changed five files: `calendarEventCreateEditDialogTemplate.inc.xhtml`, `calendarDialog.css`, `calendarDialogRow.css`, `browser_calendarEventCategoryRow.js`, and `calendarEventCreateEditDialog.xhtml`. It removes the toggle-heading presentation, aligns the row inset, places chips before Add category, and matches gaps, chip metrics, icons, action styling, and keyboard focus. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
